description: The file is the main application component (App.tsx) for a React-based task management system. It handles user authentication, board data fetching, real-time updates, and toggling between dashboard and task board views.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the current board data and updates the component state.

methods.name: handleCreateDefaultColumns
methods.description: Creates default columns ('Backlog', 'In Progress', 'Done') if none exist.

methods.name: onOpenTask
methods.description: Sets the current task to display in the modal.
